jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Our Opportunity

The Inbound Technology and Data Science team is an integral part of Chewy’s Operations Technology organization. Our team builds the products and science-based capabilities that maintain a healthy flow of inbound volume across Chewy’s 13 core fulfillment centers, ensuring our network has the right inventory and labor in place to serve pet parents.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chewy’s inbound planning products. This role will lead the evolution of our 13-week planning process from manually coordinated workflows toward scalable, automated, and science-based solutions.

This highly visible and cross-functional role will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Replenishment, Transportation, In Stock, and Fulfillment Center Operations teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that the ecosystem of inbound products and teams works together effectively to support near-term operational needs and Chewy’s long-term growth. The ideal candidate is a clear communicator and trusted partner who uses data to influence decisions, align senior leaders, and translate complex supply chain challenges into scalable technical solutions.

What You’ll Do
- Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chewy’s inbound planning capabilities, with a focus on automation, scalability, and science-based decision-making.

- Own the technical products supporting the 13-week inbound planning process across Chewy’s 13 core fulfillment centers.

- Identify opportunities to innovate and improve how inbound volume, labor, inventory, capacity, and operational constraints are planned across the fulfillment network.

- Partner with engineering and data science teams to translate complex business and operational needs into clear product requirements, technical capabilities, and use cases.

- Work alongside engineering and data science throughout the development lifecycle to scope, test, launch, and continuously improve inbound planning solutions.

- Coordinate across Replenishment, Transportation, In Stock, and Fulfillment Center Operations teams, including both business and technology partners, to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and ensure the broader product ecosystem works together effectively.

- Build trust with stakeholders by using data to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive clear and objective decisions.

- Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners to establish shared priorities and alignment on inbound planning strategies.

- Define and track key performance indicators that measure planning quality, network health, operational efficiency, and product impact.

- Develop clear product documentation, including vision documents, roadmaps, business requirements, user stories, and leadership updates.

- Identify risks and dependencies early, establish mitigation plans, and communicate changes or tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.

- Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in supply chain planning, automation, optimization, and data science to inform product strategy and drive innovation.

What You’ll Need
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager or in a comparable product role, owning and driving complex technical roadmaps from strategy through execution.

- Demonstrated experience translating complex business and operational challenges into scalable technical products and clear requirements.

- Proven ability to develop product vision documents, roadmaps, business requirements, user stories, epics, and use cases and to work effectively with agile development teams.

- Experience partnering closely with engineering and data science teams throughout product discovery, development, testing, launch, and iteration.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to generate insights, evaluate tradeoffs, and influence decisions.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts for senior leaders and diverse cross-functional audiences.

- Demonstrated ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.

- Experience managing dependencies across multiple products, systems, teams, and operational workflows.

- Passion for building products that improve operational efficiency, decision quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.

Bonus
- Experience building or managing supply chain planning, inbound logistics, inventory, transportation, labor planning, or fulfillment technology products.

- Experience using SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI to analyze performance and support product decisions.

- Familiarity with data science and optimization techniques, including forecasting, simulation, machine learning, and scheduling or network optimization algorithms.

- Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud computing, and microservices architectures.

- Experience developing products that replace manual planning processes with automated, data-driven decision-making.

What You’ll Get
- A place where you can be your authentic self and grow your career. Our pet parents and partners are from everywhere—different places and different walks of life. It is what makes them unique. Likewise, Chewtopians are encouraged to bring their perspectives to deliver on our mission!

- Work in a culture that cares, with managers who value you and your career journey. Be empowered to think big, thrive on delivering results, and become your best.

- Opportunities to develop meaningful connections with a diverse group of Chewtopians through Team Member Resource Groups and to celebrate inclusivity through company events, programs, and activities.

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, in addition to wellness programs and resources that enable you to be your best self in and outside of work.

The base salary range for this role is $141,000 - $225,000.00. - The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com .

jobs.title: Associate Director, Product Management – Emerging Customer Experiences
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Associate Director, Product Management – Emerging Customer Experiences
C07 Individual Contributor

Our Opportunity
At Chewy, our mission is to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere. They are family, and we are passionate about exceeding their expectations at every interaction.
To support our mission, we are seeking an Associate Director, Product Management – Emerging Customer Experiences . In this C07 individual-contributor role, you will own the strategy and roadmap for a connected commerce and service experience serving customers with complex purchasing and operating needs.
You will translate customer insights, market signals, and business economics into a long-term product vision; validate solutions through research, experimentation, and controlled pilots; and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver scalable capabilities. This role requires operating autonomously, bringing structure to ambiguous problems, influencing senior leaders, and balancing near-term customer learning with Chewy’s long-term product and technology strategy.

What You’ll Do
- Product Strategy and Vision: Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a substantial customer experience spanning account, purchase, fulfillment, and post-purchase interactions.
- Customer Discovery and Validation: Combine quantitative analysis, qualitative research, and customer feedback to anticipate needs that may not be readily apparent from existing data. Design pilots and experiments that validate customer value, operational feasibility, and business impact.
- Roadmap Development and Prioritization: Develop and apply a prioritization framework based on customer impact, business value, complexity, feasibility, and economics. Manage tradeoffs, dependencies, critical paths, and product risks.
- Cross-Functional Product Delivery: Mobilize a virtual team across Design, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Customer Care, Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and other business teams to move initiatives from concept through launch and optimization.
- Scalable Product Architecture: Partner with technical teams to determine where existing Chewy capabilities can be reused, extended, or connected and where new investments are required. Review customer and technical designs, identify risks, and proactively drive mitigation.
- Executive Communication and Alignment: Write crisp, data-driven product documents—including vision documents, PRFAQs, business cases, and roadmap recommendations—that clarify customer needs, business requirements, and decisions for senior leadership.
- Measurement and Optimization: Establish success metrics across adoption, customer experience, revenue, cost to serve, and operational performance. Use results to recommend whether solutions should scale, evolve, or stop.
- Product Management Excellence: Strengthen product-development mechanisms, experimentation practices, delivery quality, and execution velocity across the initiative.

What You’ll Need
- Educational Background and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 7+ years of product-management experience within ecommerce, marketplaces, platforms, customer experience, or a similarly complex environment.
- End-to-End Product Ownership: Demonstrated success owning a substantial product or portfolio of connected products from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and scale.
- Customer-First Product Management: Strong ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative research, anticipate unmet customer needs, and translate insights into clear product solutions.
- Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Experience developing business cases, defining KPIs, designing experiments, evaluating economics, and making data-informed investment decisions.
- Technical Acumen: Ability to engage meaningfully in discussions involving platform architecture, systems integrations, data, technical dependencies, and build-versus-reuse tradeoffs.
- Ambiguity and Execution: Ability to put structure around open-ended, multidimensional problems; distinguish reversible decisions from one-way doors; and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.
- Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting complex product strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to align and influence teams without direct authority while balancing functional priorities with broader organizational goals.
- Product Delivery Expertise: Experience with agile product development, requirements definition, customer and technical design reviews, testing, UAT, launch readiness, and post-launch optimization.
- Preferred Experience: Experience with B2B, multi-user commerce, account or platform products, payments, fulfillment, or other complex purchasing ecosystems is a plus.

The base salary range for this role is $166,000 - $265,000.00. - The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Our Team
Chewy’s Pet Health team is on a mission to make pet healthcare simpler, more accessible, and a little less stressful for pet parents (and their furry sidekicks). From scaling telehealth to   optimizing   use r   experiences across the   pet prescription space ,   w e’re   building products that genuinely make a difference in how people care for their pets.

Engineering is at the heart of that journey.   We’re   a curious, collaborative group that cares just as much about why   we’re   building something   as how   we build. We celebrate wins, learn from missteps without blame, and continuously raise the bar for ourselves and each other. Whether   it’s   contributing to shared platforms or partnering across teams,   you’ll   find plenty of opportunities to make a real impact and grow along the way

Our Opportunity:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager – Healthcare B2C at our Boston, MA or Bellevue, WA office. This role will own the portfolio planning, technical coordination, and delivery support for enhancing Chewy’s Healthcare B2C platforms like Telemedicine including integrations with checkout, payments, and other partner integrations across our e-commerce and Healthcare teams.

As an Sr TPM, you will operate as a single-threaded owner for large, ambiguous, and business-critical initiatives, influencing strategy and driving execution across multiple teams and organizations.

What You’ll Do:
• Own portfolio management for the Healthcare B2C services domain, driving roadmap alignment and execution across multiple teams ensuring transparency at all levels including executive leadership..
• Act as the end-to-end owner for large, cross-functional programs (e.g., telemedicine expansion), from concept through launch and post-launch optimization..
• Partner with business and engineering leaders on annual OP1 planning, quarterly business review processes and documentation, and onsite team strategic planning meetings. .
• Drive planning mechanisms that balance business impact, engineering capacity, and operational risk, making tradeoff decisions in ambiguous environments..
• Partner with product, engineering, leaders to define multi-quarter strategy and execution plans tied to key metrics such as authorization rates, conversion, payment cost, and fraud loss..
• Influence technical architecture and system design discussions to ensure scalable, resilient, and secure payment systems, without directly managing engineers..
• Define and enforce mechanisms for operational excellence, including SLA/SLO tracking, incident management, and continuous improvement for payment success rates and latency..
• Identify, surface, and mitigate risks across programs including cross-team dependencies.
• Own executive communication, including bi-weekly Flash updates, providing clear, concise updates on program health, risks, tradeoffs, and business impact, and driving alignment across senior stakeholders..
• Establish and scale mechanisms (roadmaps, metrics, dashboards, rituals) that improve predictability and execution quality across the Healthcare B2C organization.

What You’ll Need:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field and 7+ years of experience (or master’s degree with 5+ years of experience)
• 5+ years of experience in technical program management, with demonstrated ownership of large-scale, cross-team initiatives
• Experience with web/mobile technologies (React, TypeScript) and backend systems (e.g., Java, APIs, distributed systems)
• Experience with APM(Datadog, Dynatrace) and AWS technologies ( EC2, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB)
• Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous problem spaces, defining structure, priorities, and execution plans
• Strong understanding of B2C web applications
• Demonstrated experience influencing technical architecture and business strategy across multiple teams without direct authority
• Experience driving multi-quarter programs with measurable business impact (e.g., revenue lift, cost reduction, reliability improvements)
• Experience with Agile methodologies and delivering complex systems at scale
• Preferred: Experience in high scale e-commerce platforms.
